cacheColdDefinition: new WebView disk profile, unchanged owned manager data, no previous product or associated WebView process alive
processWarmDefinition: normal exit then new process using the same just-populated WebView disk profile and manager data
osColdDefinition: not measured: no OS reboot, standby-list purge or machine cache reset
readiness: time from Process.Start through the first successful native Settings-button invocation and observed Settings route text
readinessLimit: bounded UI Automation polling adds timing overhead; retain bracket and polling duration rather than claiming sub-poll precision
p95Method: nearest-rank percentile, 20 observations per version and mode
